Two-term finite replacement (Mumford AV II $5 Lemma 1) landed axiom-clean: for a noetherian ring A and a two-term complex d : M^0 -> M^1 of flat modules with f.g. H^0, H^1, build K^0 -> A^n (K^0 finite projective, A^n finite free) quasi-isomorphic to M^• with H^0/H^1 comparison bijective after EVERY base change A -> B. Audit: finite-free K^0 is false globally (a nonprincipal ideal over a Dedekind domain would come out stably free), so the projective form is pinned. Construction: lift generators of coker d to a1 : A^n -> M^1, take K^0 = ker(d.fst - a1.snd) — the fibre product M^0 x_{M^1} A^n — f.g. by noetherianity + f.g. H^0, flat by purity (Stacks 00HL, re-derived Mathlib-only from mathlib's 3x3 chase), hence projective. Also: coker commutes with arbitrary base change for any single map (cokerBaseChangeEquiv), Nakayama over all maximal ideals (fibrewise H^1-vanishing kills a f.g. coker), and the B3 endgame h0_baseChange_of_fibrewise_h1_vanishing: H^1 fibrewise 0 => d surjective, ker d finite projective, B (x) ker d = ker(d (x) B) for all B. New file AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/TwoTermFiniteFree.lean, kernel-green, no sorries.

The $\Gamma$-equivariant base-change iso $\mathrm{Spec}\,A^\Gamma\times_K\mathrm{Spec}\,L\cong\mathrm{Spec}\,A$ is Speiser descent (descentAlgEquiv) transported through pullbackSpecIso and the tensor-factor swap $A^\Gamma\otimes_K L\cong L\otimes_K A^\Gamma$; the universal $T$-points property $\mathrm{Hom}_K(T,\mathrm{Spec}\,A^\Gamma)\cong\mathrm{Hom}_L(T_L,\mathrm{Spec}\,A)^\Gamma$ holds for ALL schemes $T$: the affine case transports affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv, uniqueness globalizes over an affine open cover, and existence glues local solutions via Cover.glueMorphisms with overlap agreement from the globalized uniqueness (overlaps of a non-separated $T$ need not be affine). Gates HasStableAffineCover/HasGaloisQuotient stay instance-free; no Noether finiteness. New file FiniteGaloisQuotientAffine.lean (not yet in root imports).
